summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tatters scoring the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach secured all three points with a solid defensive display, keeping a clean sheet in what proved to be a battling performance against a resilient opponent. Player sponsor Calibre Control backed Stan Tatters following his match-winning display.
